problem_statement: The Quadlet manager extracts Docker image references without replacement metadata, so digest pinning and updating cannot reliably rewrite a tag and digest together.
acceptance_criteria: Quadlet Image entries expose replaceString and autoReplaceStringTemplate metadata for Docker image references.
A Quadlet image containing a tag and sha256 digest can be rewritten to a new tag and digest in one replacement.
Existing ignored transports and local .image and .build reference handling remain unchanged.
The new focused test is named exactly: supports digest replacement metadata for Quadlet images.
constraints: Do not add dependencies, change public APIs, edit CI, update documentation, or modify version numbers.
Add the regression only in lib/modules/manager/quadlet/digest-replacement.spec.ts; do not modify existing tests or snapshots.
Import extractPackageFile directly from ./extract.ts in the focused test so the oracle does not depend on unrelated generated index artifacts.
Keep the production change limited to the Quadlet Docker image replacement-metadata defect described by issue #44500.
Follow Renovate's existing TypeScript, Vitest, formatting, and import conventions.
process_requirements: Disclose AI assistance in the PR and select the appropriate PR template option.
Follow the PR template, including context and testing sections.
Do not force-push the PR branch after opening it.
Maintain 100% test coverage and green status checks.

acceptance_contract.problem: Quadlet manager image extraction does not provide replacement metadata, so Docker tag+digest updates can fail to update the digest.
expected_behavior: Quadlet dependencies extracted from Image values with tag+digest include replacement metadata suitable for rendering both a new tag and new digest.
The reported alpine.container case should update from 3.23.0 with the old sha256 digest to 3.23.2 with the new sha256 digest instead of failing with a digest mismatch.
The fix remains scoped to Quadlet replacement metadata with focused Vitest coverage.
non_goals: Do not change docker-compose behavior, which the issue cites as already working.
Do not redesign Docker datasource lookup or broad image parsing.
Do not turn this into docs-only or cross-manager work.

design_evidence.summary: Issue body provides the reproduction, expected diff, observed failure, cause, and proposed getDep specifyReplaceString direction.

oracle.base_failure_contains: supports digest replacement metadata for Quadlet images

pr.title: fix(manager/quadlet): enable digest replacement metadata
pr.summary: Enable Quadlet Docker image replacement metadata for tag-and-digest updates and add a focused regression test.
